Parent requirement: 2 test(s) a year, met. Doing only what the parent asks leaves 99% of the year untested.
To keep untested time at or below 10%: 540 tests a year, which is continuous validation (automated validation on every surface-changing release, with human depth tests on a schedule).
Assumptions: Tests are evenly spaced across the year. Surface-changing releases arrive at a steady rate; a change lands at a random point after a test. A test stops being valid at the next release that changes the attack surface. Every number is entered by the user. Defaults are synthetic and illustrative.
Limits: Arithmetic on stated assumptions, shown on screen. It does not predict breaches. Not a compliance determination and not a standard. The tier ladder is ApexVector's own. A release that changes the attack surface is a judgment call. The share you enter drives the result. A test after every surface-changing release would narrow the gap further; the model reports how many that would be.
Decision: for a person to accept or reject.
